tools.name: research
tools.description: One private markets question in one call: BDC and private credit lenders, borrowers, loans, maturities and non-accrual, sponsors, advisers, teams, pension commitments. Reads SEC filings (BDC schedules, Form ADV, IAPD) and plan documents; returns entities, an answer from cited claims only, coverage l

tools.name: what_can_dfx_answer
tools.description: Plain-language objective in, coverage and routing out: the DFX domain that answers it, the arguments for that domain's search, and a free three-row sample. Covers private credit, private equity, venture, family offices, RIAs, allocators and US commercial real estate.

tools.name: resolve_name
tools.description: A firm, fund, person or company name to canonical DFX ids across every private-capital graph, with the roles the same institution holds on other graphs (manager, adviser, lender, allocator). Without a paid plan on a vertical, lists name their first 5 rows and count the rest; each answer states what

tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Search across every DFX domain by name or by filters (type, domain, state, sector, activity). Returns compact cards with stable DFX ids and a coverage note per domain. Without a paid plan on a vertical, lists name their first 5 rows and count the rest; each answer states what it withheld.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Everything DFX holds on one id: the card, relationships with sources and dates, recent events, the observations each fact traces to, and identity links to other graphs by shared CRD, CIK or EIN. detail=compact returns key facts and counts under 2 KB. Without a paid plan on a vertical, lists name the

tools.name: search_relationships
tools.description: Every published relationship touching one entity (employs, manages, invested in, lends to, owns, board member of and more), each with role, dates, currency, evidence class and source. Without a paid plan on a vertical, lists name their first 5 rows and count the rest; each answer states what it with

tools.name: relationship_path
tools.description: An evidence-backed path between two DFX ids across every graph: each hop is a published relationship with its source, or an identity link by shared CRD, CIK or EIN. NO_MATCH means no observed path within the hop budget, not that the two are unconnected. Without a paid plan on a vertical, lists name

tools.name: get_capital_paths
tools.description: Capital flow paths through one institution: plan to fund to manager to company, sponsor to borrower to facility to lender, and more. Each hop names its graph, id, role and basis, with the amount where disclosed and a rule-graded confidence. Without a paid plan on a vertical, lists name their first 5

tools.name: changes_since
tools.description: What DFX learned since a time: with a domain, that graph's events by first sight (dfx_id narrows them to one entity), each labelled NEW_EVENT, NEWLY_OBSERVED_HISTORICAL or SCHEDULED_FUTURE; without one, real estate changes since a cursor.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: A claim in, SUPPORTED, PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED or UNKNOWN out, with the cited evidence rows. Names resolve only to records carrying that name; absence of evidence is UNKNOWN, never a contradiction.

tools.name: get_credit_provider
tools.description: A credit manager or a BDC: classes, advised BDCs from each 10-K, quarterly portfolio (fair value, principal, borrowers, marks, PIK), largest facilities and sponsors financed. Accepts a private credit id or a BDC's CIK. detail=compact returns key facts under 2 KB. Without a paid plan on a vertical, l

tools.name: get_borrower_facilities
tools.description: Every facility a borrower has on the BDC tape (kind, lien, principal as a lower bound, pricing, maturity) with each BDC holding a piece. group_by=lender: one row per BDC, its tranches summed, cited to its own filing. Without a paid plan on a vertical, lists name their first 5 rows and count the rest

tools.name: search_ria_advisor_moves
tools.description: Advisors who left one firm and registered at another, from IAPD registration dates: the person, from and to firms with class, the end and begin dates, the gap and the move type; with a firm, by branch state. Bulk re-registrations are excluded unless asked for. Without a paid plan on a vertical, list

tools.name: search_allocator_commitments
tools.description: Public plans' own commitment disclosures, one row per line: plan, fund as printed, manager, amount, status, dates, vintage, re-up, the plan's own performance figures and the source document with a quote. Without a paid plan on a vertical, lists name their first 5 rows and count the rest; each answer

tools.name: get_research_records
tools.description: DFX's own published research records and investigations: each finding with its permanent id, version, as-of date, denominator, method link, sources and citation line. With record_id, the evidence manifest: every claim with its basis (reported, DFX calculation, DFX inference) and source. A record wit

tools.name: watch_create
tools.description: Save a private credit investigation for this account: a research question and/or borrowers, a sponsor's borrowers or a lender's book, and the changes to watch (lenders, maturity, spread, PIK, marks). `since` starts it at a past date. Returns a watch id and checkpoint. Needs a DFX account key.

tools.name: watch_list
tools.description: This account's watches with status, latest checkpoint, reads used and cost. Needs a DFX account key.

tools.name: watch_changes
tools.description: Material changes since a checkpoint: each with its filing, filing date, a check against the lender's own rows, NEW_EVENT or NEWLY_OBSERVED_HISTORICAL, a materiality score with its rubric, and duplicates folded. Returns the next checkpoint; a repeated call returns the same delivery.

tools.name: watch_reevaluate
tools.description: Re-tests the conclusions recorded at a checkpoint (maturity, mark, lenders, performing) against what changed since, and diffs a saved investigation's claims against the question asked now.

tools.name: watch_cancel
tools.description: Cancels a watch: no further deliveries, the quota slot is freed, earlier deliveries stay readable.
